articles.body:
When a region controlled by the company is attacked by an invasion or a rebellion, an additional Rebellion Crisis is triggered in every region with unrest cubes.

Is the modifier on the event tile added to the attack power of every additional Rebellion Crisis? Or only the Primary Crisis?

I.e. Is the Attack Power of the additional Rebellion Crisis = the amount of unrest cubes present? Or = the amount of unrest cubes present + the Event Tile Modifier?

Or only the Primary Crisis?<br/><br/>I.e. Is the Attack Power of the additional Rebellion Crisis = the amount of unrest cubes present? Or = the amount of unrest cubes present + the Event Tile Modifier?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body: The tile only affects the primary crisis.
